name: crucible-local
description: Check claims against local evidence files and get a verdict for each claim.

workspace.title: Readable workspace
workspace.description: Local directory this plugin may read. Choose a folder that holds only the files you want checked.

process_consent.title: Allow this measurement command
process_consent.description: Optional. The approved command runs with your OS permissions, including file writes and network access. It is not sandboxed.

measure_command.title: Fixed measurement command (JSON argv)
measure_command.description: Optional. JSON argv array with an absolute executable. Leave empty unless measurement command consent is on.
